text_block_list.text: One day, while having a PreFighter watch party with Kawakami Princess...

text_block_list.name: Sebastian
text_block_list.text:
"That's not impossible, woof!
The Princess can overcome any hardship, woof!
Even riding her dreaded screamer roller coaster 10 times in a row...!"

text_block_list.name: Prifight
text_block_list.text:
""Ngh... that's right! Even if I have to cough up blood,
I'll overcome this! To master a new special move,
and to bring smiles to everyone's faces...!""

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Our next day off will be at an amusement park!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Whyyy is this happening, desu wa~~?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Even though we've been riding roller coasters
again, and again, and again..."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I don't feel like I've gotten stronger at all~~!!

Apparently inspired by the recent PreFai episode, she wanted to train on a scream machine.
In that case—

Unfolding the park map I received at the entrance,
I found what I was looking for.
choice_data_list: I know of even better training!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"‘Stealthy Steps!
The Heart-Pounding Secret Treasure of the Ninja House’...?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: *sigh* A ninja. That feels quite far removed from PreFigh's image, though...

text_block_list.name: Guide Ninja
text_block_list.text:
The secret scroll lies asleep in the back room-nin!
I need you to go retrieve it-nin!

text_block_list.name: Guide Ninja
text_block_list.text:
However... the mansion's floors are nightingale floors!!
If you don't tread quietly, you have to start over, nin-nin~~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Heh~...! That sounds rather delightful!
Understood!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what ninjas have to do with PreFie, but!
I will gladly take on that trial!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Tiptoe, stealthy steps, sneaky fe...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Migyaaah~~~~!!??
I set it off again desu wa~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Gnnnngh! One more time!
I'll definitely pull it off this time, just you see~~!"
Kawakami Princess tried the ninja mansion's trial again and again. But...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Uuuu... Every step I take, it goes 'Hokekyo, hokekyo.'
Three steps past the front door and it's already 'Hokekyo'...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Walking quietly... is as impossible as splitting
a meteor with your bare hands, you know~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Trainer?!
choice_data_list: 'A princess can overcome any hardship, woof!'

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —Kh! That line...!

text_block_list.name: Sebastian
text_block_list.text:
"That's not impossible, woof!
The Princess can overcome any hardship, woof!
Even riding her dreaded screamer roller coaster 10 times in a row...!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That is true...! Even the princess kept pushing forward
while coughing up blood, after all!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "I can't afford to get discouraged either! I'll keep trying as many times as it takes!!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Step with the left leg before the right one gives out!
Doryaaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—Yesssssss!!
I got the scroll~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fushuuu...! I can feel it...!
The new, powered-up me from ninja training!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: How strange! Even after riding the roller coaster so many times, I felt nothing at all before...!
choice_data_list: We've tackled so many challenges, after all.
We've tackled so many challenges, after all, haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That is true... The princess didn't
become strong just by riding a roller coaster.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I overcame my "weakness" and grew stronger!
That's why my Trainer decided to put my "weakness" to—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! That is magnificent, Trainer!
To notice that and prepare it so swiftly!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu! Oh Trainer, you really
do pay close attention to me, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure there's no one
who understands me better than you do!"
choice_data_list: It's my job to help you achieve what you aspire to, after all.
Making your aspirations come true is my duty, after all.
As expected of the "Legendary Trainer," right?
As expected of the "Legendary Trainer," right?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure there's no one
who understands me better than you do!"
choice_data_list: It's my job to help you achieve what you aspire to, after all.
Making your aspirations come true is my duty, after all.
As expected of the "Legendary Trainer," right?
As expected of the "Legendary Trainer," right?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Geez! Saying that makes all the muscles
in my face turn to mush~~!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Still, as a princess! And as a racing Umamusume!
I shall continue to strive toward my ideals!!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
!! ...Jeez!
Do you even realize what it means to say that?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yes... Y-Y-Yes, that is correct!!
When it comes to "The Legendary Trainer", episode 18 is a god-tier episode, but have you seen it?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Whether you haven't or even if you have!
We must go see it!! Strike while the iron is hot--!!

And with that, Kawakami Princess
took off running.
